checkpoints.quote: Retry button calls POST /api/transaction/transfer again with no idempotency key, server treats it as new transfer. Debit and credit are not in one database transaction, so first debit stays committed when credit times out.
checkpoints.reason: Both root-cause elements (missing idempotency key and non-atomic debit/credit) are clearly stated and attributed to Priya's reproduction.
